plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Military Studies-Fort Riley/Leavenworth, Emphasis of Study, Associate in General Studies - 60 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/26; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed; term totals 15/16/15/14 = 60 reconcile exactly. Footnotes: ^ ENGL 1204 or ENGL 1205 meet the English Requirement; ** MATH 1828 (or higher), QMAT 1828, STAT 1828 (or higher), QMAT 1828 strongly recommended, meet the Math & Statistics Requirement; ^^ COMM 1230 or COMM 1200 meet the Communications Requirement; ^^^ BRTN 1103 or BSTC 1036 recommended for the Barton Designated Requirement (6 sh total); *** the Arts & Humanities Requirement needs at least two courses from two different subject areas. Suggested Emphasis Electives (3 + 3 + 3 + 3 + 2 = 14 sh) from the map's list.

courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'English Requirement' (^ ENGL 1204 or ENGL 1205 meet the requirement), 3 sh (010).

courses.title: Math & statistics requirement
courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'Math & Statistics Requirement' (** MATH 1828 (or higher), QMAT 1828, STAT 1828 (or higher); QMAT 1828 strongly recommended), 3 sh (030).

courses.title: Barton designated requirement
courses.choice_note: Catalog: 'Barton Designated Requirement' (^^^ recommended BRTN 1103 or BSTC 1036), 3 sh (070).
